facts.value: The library stands on the site of the Croton Reservoir. It was torn down in 1900 after several delays.
facts.quote: The reservoir itself was eventually torn down, following numerous delays, in 1900
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://bryantpark.org/the-park/history' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'The reservoir itself was eventually torn down, following numerous delays, in 1900'

facts.value: The reservoir on the library's site covered four acres and held 20 million gallons of water from the Croton River. Its walls were a popular promenade, with Edgar Allan Poe among the walkers.
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://bryantpark.org/blog/history-of-bryant-park-before-it-was-a-park' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'held 20 million gallons of water'

facts.value: Mayor Fiorello La Guardia named the lions Patience and Fortitude in the 1930s, for the qualities he felt New Yorkers needed in the Depression.
facts.quote: Mayor Fiorello LaGuardia bestowed those names
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://www.theartnewspaper.com/news/new-york-public-library-shores-up-its-marble-lions' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'Mayor Fiorello LaGuardia bestowed those names'

facts.value: During the Rose Reading Room restoration, materials too big for the freight elevator were lifted from 40th Street by boom onto a scaffold tower on the roof, then carried in through a window.
facts.quote: boomed onto a scaffold tower erected on the roof
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://aecom.com/projects/new-york-public-library-rose-reading-room-restoration/' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'boomed onto a scaffold tower erected on the roof'

facts.value: In May 2014 a plaster rosette fell from the 52-foot ceiling of the Rose Main Reading Room. The room closed for six months for inspection and repair.
facts.quote: plaster rosette fell from the reading room
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://www.ksl.com/article/30344761/ny-public-library-reading-room-closed-by-repairs' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'plaster rosette fell from the reading room'
